The wide-binary section derives a hidden-depth cancellation identity and exact depth-minimized binding envelope, but selection can mimic a torque signal and the available cohorts are not calibrated. The Bennu reports constrain closed-pool/source-mixture histories and give conditional isotope-correlation benchmarks; raw isotope scans and an identified chemical mechanism remain missing. The older strange-metal section duplicates N561–N562 and is routed there.
